title: Accelerating Optimization via Differentiable Stopping Time
abstract: arXiv:2505.22509v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Optimization is an important module of modern machine learning applications. Tremendous efforts have been made to accelerate optimization algorithms. A common formulation is achieving a lower loss at a given time. This enables a differentiable framework with respect to the algorithm hyperparameters. In contrast, its dual, minimizing the time to reach a target loss, is believed to be non-differentiable, as the time is not differentiable. As a result, it usually serves as a conceptual framework or is optimized using zeroth-order methods. To address this limitation, we propose a differentiable stopping time and theoretically justify it based on differential equations. An efficient algorithm is designed to backpropagate through it. As a result, the proposed differentiable stopping time enables a new differentiable formulation for accelerating algorithms. translated_title: 通过可微停止时间加速优化
translated_abstract: 优化是现代机器学习应用中的重要模块。人们已经付出了巨大努力来加速优化算法。一种常见的表述是在给定时间内达到更低的损失，这使得框架相对于算法超参数是可微的。相比之下，其对偶问题——最小化达到目标损失所需的时间——被认为是不可微的，因为时间本身不可微。因此，该对偶问题通常仅作为概念性框架存在，或使用零阶方法进行优化。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了一个可微的停止时间，并基于微分方程从理论上对其进行了论证。同时，我们设计了一种高效的算法来通过它进行反向传播。由此，所提出的可微停止时间为加速算法提供了一种全新的可微表述。我们进一步讨论了其应用，例如在线超参数调优以及学习……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于微分方程理论的“可微停止时间”概念及其高效反向传播算法，首次使“最小化达到目标损失所需时间”这一传统上不可微的对偶优化问题变为可微表述，从而为加速优化算法开辟了新框架，并可应用于在线超参数调优等场景。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a differentiable stopping time, theoretically justified via differential equations and equipped with an efficient backpropagation algorithm, which for the first time makes the traditionally non-differentiable dual problem of minimizing the time to reach a target loss differentiable, enabling a new formulation for accelerating optimization algorithms with applications such as online hyperparameter tuning.
